adjudication.باريكم: REJECTED b-r-' (بارئكم, your Maker) -- hamza, not kaf
adjudication.بركنهۥ: REJECTED r-k-n (بِرُكْنِهِۦ, with his pillar) -- the ب is the preposition bi-

distribution.note: The root is overwhelmingly NOMINAL in the text (71 vs 16). 2:228 قُرُوٓءٍ is the same root used with no reciting sense at all, which is the one datum here bearing on whether q-r-' is semantically confined to 'read'. It is reported because it was pre-registered, not because of which way it cuts -- and on its own, one ayah is ONE_WING under the Janah rule and settles nothing.

corrections.the_268_to_1_ratio: There is no such ratio. 268 was the count of VERBAL designations of آمنوا in v2; 1 was the count of NOMINAL designations of مسلم. Two different measurements on two different axes are not a ratio, and dividing them means nothing.
corrections.islam_collapsed_from_MUTABLE: It did not. v2 classified islam as FIXED. v3 collapsed FIXED to no-verdict under the Janah rule. It was never MUTABLE.
corrections.the_screen_is_the_first_implementation_o: That is a Layer 3 naming, not a result. The screen is a token matcher with pre-registered gates. Calling it a scale of structural equity does not make it one.
corrections.iqra_from_a_pregnant_she_camel: This is a claim from traditional lexicography -- precisely the source N159 rules out as yielding 'only a plausible opinion'. It is not tested here and this run gives it no support.

post_run_disclosures.D1_WHAT_LICENSED_MEANS: It does not test, support or evaluate any of the READINGS. It does not evaluate E = U*D, the cascade product E = U*prod(D_i), revocation latency, a Bayesian updating engine, Al-Mizan, or the claim that Iqra derives from a pregnant she-camel. None of those is a morphological claim and none is measured anywhere in this repository. A licensed root means the inquiry may proceed, NOT that the conclusion is correct.
post_run_disclosures.D2_THE_V3_RULE_DOES_NOT_GENERALISE: v3's gates concerned f-s-h and j-l-s, where wasla rescues the stem and the first radical is not a proclitic letter. Those results are unaffected and v3 is not re-scored. But the rule does NOT generalise to roots beginning with a proclitic letter, and saying so is the point of this entry.

primary_verdict: 6/7. All four roots are LICENSED: IQRA_quran, N157_barakah, N167_sulalah, N182_al_asr. Each clears both of OQM's own rules, so for each of these narratives the Quran can be used to define the term internally -- unlike 58:11, where N159 showed the same rules failing on purpose. This says the inquiry may proceed. It does NOT say any reading is correct. The run also had to correct its own instrument first: v3's proclitic rule rejected 27:8 بُورِكَ, the very ayah N157 is built on, while accepting four suffix artefacts.
